name: Ember portrait / character in the details
art: The original asset is site/assets/motion/ember-portrait.webp. If adapting the subject, create a comparably detailed original portrait with copy space; generic stock imagery or a flat vector head is below this target.

properties.label: Oversized portrait with protected copy
properties.text: Let an oversized synthetic portrait occupy the right and most of the vertical field while strong uppercase type sits in clear darker space at left. Finish with a quiet material caption and three inspection views. On mobile, recompose around the face and protect a lower message region.

properties.label: Detailed synthetic object portrait
properties.text: Use a richly authored object portrait with an amber curved visor, complex face enclosure, tiny mesh, gaskets, braiding, fasteners and subtle surface wear. Preserve character and detail at several scales rather than producing a glossy toy.

properties.label: Graphite ceramic, dark metal and amber glass
properties.text: Combine matte graphite ceramic, layered dark metal and curved amber glass. Give the face and enclosure different roughness, with long reflected light shapes and warm internal glints for depth.

properties.label: Portrait, visor and mechanism crops
properties.text: Portrait, The visor and The mechanism select deliberate crops and matching explanatory captions. Subtle pointer reframing may support inspection, but a raster asset does not promise unrestricted orbit or moving facial geometry.

properties.label: Portrait detail and crop check
properties.text: Inspect visor mesh, metal seams and cable detail at full size. Every selected crop must preserve readable text, visible controls, material contrast and the subject's personality.
